dict.string: Capture an image and available depth data when you ask the assistant to inspect something.
Find people you ask about in the contacts you allow, so you can review a message, email or call to the correct person.
Read calendars you select to find available time and review event changes. You choose whether the assistant's connected model can use this information.
Read reminder lists you select and create, edit or complete reminders after your review.
Read one current location when you approve an assistant request. The app shows which model will receive the location and does not track it in the background.
Transcribe your voice into an editable message when you tap the microphone.
Turn speech into an editable draft. Voice input is enabled only when on-device recognition is available.

Read the measurements, activity, symptoms, medication and other Health records you select when they are relevant to your request. You choose what Health shares and whether a connected model can use the result.
Read clinical records you select to help you understand and organize your own health information.
Connect to a model server on your own computer when you select a LAN endpoint.
